_comment: Survivor-count ratchet for the single mutmut 3 run: increases fail the job; decreases tighten this baseline. OBSERVED: 685 survivors from a local mutmut 3.8.1 run on the 4.32.0 release candidate (rc after the review fixes; 12190 mutants, 42 timeouts, 18 without tests), 2026-11-25. Down from 706: the 1.x/2.x round and its review fixes added survivors; tests now kill them (socket write token, /init identification and refresh, fault events, partial GraphQL replies) and four verified-equivalent lines carry pragma: no mutate with a reason. Equivalent mutants remain in the count; only verified unobservable lines use pragma: no mutate with a reason.
